segments.he: גְּמָ׳ תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן: מַחֲנֶה הַיּוֹצֵאת לְמִלְחֶמֶת הָרְשׁוּת מוּתָּרִין בְּגֶזֶל עֵצִים יְבֵשִׁים. רַבִּי יְהוּדָה בֶּן תֵּימָא אוֹמֵר: אַף חוֹנִין בְּכׇל מָקוֹם. וּבִמְקוֹם שֶׁנֶּהֶרְגוּ שָׁם נִקְבָּרִין.
segments.en: «GEMARA:» «The Sages taught» in a Tosefta: With regard to a military «camp that goes out to» wage «an optional war, it is permitted» for the soldiers «to steal dry wood. Rabbi Yehuda ben Teima says: They may also encamp in any location,» even if they damage the field in which they are encamped. «And in the place where they were killed, there they are buried» and the owner of the site cannot object, as moving the corpse for burial elsewhere dishonors the dead.
